svg.text: Import graph vs Architectural Property Graph
Same slice of the hexagonal reference project ("cancel a booking"), extracted for real. Left: the edges an import checker has. Right: what the APG adds.
What the APG adds on the same six files
6 files, 6 import arrows. No layer, no type,
Coloured boxes = files with the layer the spec assigns. Imports are still in the APG; they are hidden here.
Source: extractAPG (V13_APG2_OPTIONS, components from the spec) on tests/fixtures/v1.3-reference/hexagonal, clean variant. Data: Docs/presentation-kit/data/hexagonal.clean.apg2.json
APG v2 = the extractor option apg2 (Docs/v1.3/apg2-design.md), off by default in v1.3.
